authNote: Every operation's OpenAPI doc says 'Authorization: Bearer [access_token]' — that is WRONG for the personal-access API key this project uses. Empirically confirmed working: 'Authorization: token <key>'. Bearer returns HTTP 400 {"code":200058,"message":"User in token does not exist."}. See specs/rest/index.json.

operations.description: Returns all tasks and appointments attached to the given lead. Caller must have manage permission on the lead.

parameters.name: leadId
parameters.description: ID of the lead whose tasks and appointments to return.

operations.description:
Creates a new task or appointment on the target lead. Whether an appointment or a regular task is created depends on the payload's type field.

Notes:
- content, assignedRole, leadId and endAt are required.
- Caller must have manage permission on the lead.
- The response contains only the new entry's ID under the 'taskId' key.

Returns tasks assigned to the caller, sorted by startTime descending. Supports cursor-based pagination via currentId (offset) + limit.

Notes:
- currentId must be >= 0 (INVALID_PARAMETER otherwise).
- limit must be in [1, 100] (LIMIT_NOT_VALID otherwise).
- timeZoneCode selects how start/end times are formatted; when omitted, the caller's configured timezone is used.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: User ID to query tasks for. Defaults to the current authenticated user if not provided.

parameters.name: currentId
parameters.description: Cursor-based pagination anchor. Pass the last returned item's id to fetch the next page. Default 0 (start from beginning).

parameters.name: timeZoneCode
parameters.description: IANA timezone code (e.g. 'America/New_York'). If not provided, falls back to the user's configured timezone.

operations.description: Deletes a task or appointment by ID. Caller must have manage permission on the entry's lead.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: ID of the task or appointment to delete.

operations.description:
Returns a single task or appointment by ID. Tasks and appointments share the same taskId namespace; the endpoint resolves the target automatically.

Caller must have manage permission on the task's lead.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: ID of the task or appointment to retrieve.

operations.description:
Partially updates a task or appointment. Only non-null fields in the request body are applied.

Notes:
- To mark an entry as completed or not, use the finish / unfinish endpoints instead.
- At least one of content, startAt, endAt, address must be supplied; an entirely empty payload returns 400 MISSING_PARAMETER.
- Caller must have manage permission on the entry's lead.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: ID of the task or appointment to update.

operations.description: Marks a task or appointment as completed. Caller must have manage permission on the entry's lead. Smart-plan tasks cannot be finished through this endpoint (TASK_IS_SMARTPLAN).

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: ID of the task or appointment to finish.

operations.description: Reverts a task or appointment back to the not-completed state. Caller must have manage permission on the entry's lead.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: ID of the task or appointment to revert to not-completed.
